scenes.audio: Verbatim tennis sound effects: the sharp 'pop' of the ball hitting the racket strings, the squeak of sneakers on the hard court surface, and the muffled impact of the ball landing. The crowd reacts with gasps and applause as the rally intensifies.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A professional tennis match on a blue hard court with Qatar ExxonMobil Open branding. A player in a pink polo shirt and white shorts hits a backhand from the near court. His opponent, in a light green sleeveless shirt and shorts, returns the ball from the far side. The camera is static, high-angle. The lighting is bright and uniform, typical of a televised night match. The players move across the court with agile footing.

scenes.audio: Commentator: "Lehecka's done superbly!" Crowds cheering and clapping loudly.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in the pink polo, approximately 20-25 years old, with short brown hair and an athletic build, pumps his fist and shouts in celebration. He is walking towards the center of his baseline. The audience in the background is seated, many clapping. The lighting is direct stadium lighting.

scenes.audio: Continued loud crowd cheers and applause.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A blonde woman in the audience, roughly 40 years old, wearing a black top, claps enthusiastically with a joyful facial expression. The focus is sharp on her, with a shallow depth of field blurring the spectators behind her.

scenes.audio: Rhythmic sound of ball strikes and footwear sliding on the court. Crowd ambient noise.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Return to the high-angle wide view of the court. The player in the pink polo serves from the far side. The player in the green sleeveless shirt, approximately 19-21 years old, with short dark hair and a muscular build, returns from the near side. They engage in a baseline rally, moving side-to-side.

scenes.audio: Subdued applause and general stadium atmosphere.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in the green sleeveless shirt walks toward the back of the court with a neutral, focused expression. He is wiping his forehead with his wristband. The background shows corporate logos and the stadium seating.

scenes.audio: The loud grunt of the server followed by the ball hit. The umpire calls the score (inaudible/muffled).
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: The player in the green shirt serves from the near side toward the far side. The player in the pink polo returns. The ball goes out of bounds on the second hit.

scenes.audio: Commentator: "That game, Lehecka."
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in the pink polo runs toward the baseline, turning his head slightly. He wears white wristbands. A ball boy and a digital clock are visible in the background.

scenes.audio: Commentator: "For the game, the Alcaraz forehand looking just a fraction vulnerable."
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A man in the stands, approximately 35-40, with a beard and a pink hoodie over a white baseball cap, watches intently with a serious expression. A blonde man next to him is also visible.

scenes.audio: Succession of loud racket impacts and player grunts ('Ha!', 'Ugh!'). Increasing crowd noise as the rally goes on.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: The match continues with a long rally. The player in pink is on the far side; the player in green is on the near side. Both players display high-intensity movement, utilizing deep groundstrokes and lateral sprints.

scenes.audio: Commentator: "Such a good level right now!" Loud roar from the audience.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in green pumps his fist and walks away from the camera. The crowd behind him is standing and cheering.

scenes.audio: Standard match sounds. Commentator: "Good pressure."
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: The player in pink serves from the far side. The player in green misses the return, and the ball bounces toward the camera side.

scenes.audio: Commentator: "And he found himself down a break early on, but it did not deter Jiri Lehecka."
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The camera pans across the stadium seating, showing a large crowd of spectators in various attire, including traditional Qatari dress (thobes and hijabs). The lighting is bright and cool-toned.

scenes.audio: Crowd murmur.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in pink walks past the camera with his racket in hand, looking down.

scenes.audio: Quick, successive 'pop' sounds of the ball hitting the racket.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A serve and volley sequence. The player in green is at the net, performing a backhand volley. The player in pink is deep behind the baseline.

scenes.audio: Commentator: "Been a very good..." (cut off by crowd).
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in green celebrates toward the crowd, pumping his fist. The background features blue court walls and white branding.

scenes.audio: Intense breathing and ball strikes.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Rally from the far baseline by the player in pink. The player in green attempts a passing shot down the line.

scenes.audio: Applause.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in green jogs across the court, looking at his opponent.

scenes.audio: The crowd begins to cheer mid-point as the players execute difficult shots. Umpire: "0:59" (referring to clock).
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A long, grueling baseline rally. Both players are hitting with high topspin. The player in green eventually hits a winner that the player in pink cannot reach.

scenes.audio: Commentator: "Oh, that is special!"
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in green brings his fingers to his lips in a 'hush' or 'focused' gesture, then pumps his fist. He is sweating visibly.

scenes.audio: Player: "VAMOS!" Commentator: "Game!"
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Final sequence of play. The player in green serves, the player in pink returns long. The player in green shouts 'Yes!' and pumps his fist.

scenes.audio: Commentator: "This has been a high-quality encounter from the off... Jiri Lehecka inflicts just a second defeat of the year on Carlos Alcaraz. 6-4, 6-3." Loud, sustained standing ovation from the crowd.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: The two players meet at the net. They shake hands and share a brief embrace, showing sportsmanship. They then walk toward their respective benches. The camera stays wide, capturing the full stadium atmosphere under the lights.
